title: Polarisation-resolved identification of spontaneous four-wave mixing processes in a multimode fused tapered fibre coupler
summary: Integrated quantum photonics benefits from photon-pair sources that generate photons directly in waveguides, where they can be efficiently collected, routed, and manipulated. Here, we investigate spontaneous four-wave mixing (SFWM) in a fused tapered-fibre microcoupler formed from two single-mode fibres, and report four contributions.
